text:
The dish is a square dinner plate, roughly 26 cm across, so I used that as the scale. On it sit about 14 cubes of cantaloupe (or possibly papaya), each roughly 2.5–3 cm on a side and weighing about 10–12 g. That puts the total at around 150 g of fruit. Cantaloupe has roughly 34 kcal per 100 g, which gives about 50 kcal. There is no visible oil or sauce to add.
